meta.title: A-Share Analyzer
meta.description: Deep single-stock health check plus screening: enter a name to get exact market-cap tier, PE/PB, an announcement risk scan (investigation, delisting risk, impairments, inquiry letters — routine filings filtered out to avoid false positives), ST/STAR/BSE exclusion checks, technicals, capital flow and chip structure, with a verdict, entry/stop references and position sizing. Also supports 5-day MA breakout screening.
